Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied graphic faithfully. Preserve the exact main object's geometry, camera pose, proportions, texture and material: a single broad polished optical-metal annular disc, seen in three-quarter perspective, its elliptical outer contour diagonally ascending from lower left to upper right, a broad gently concave satin-gloss face and a raised concentric inner lip around the hole. Smooth machined continuous surfaces and softly beveled bright thin outer rim. This is ONE continuous annular dish, NOT a twisted ribbon, split shell, torus tube, flower or separate pieces.
Remove the entire sphere from the center. Reconstruct the formerly occluded inner rim cleanly and make the whole central opening empty and transparent.
Shift ONLY the reflection colors to domfx palette: dark graphite #14151B and #292A35, cool silver #C2C5DB, bright soft highlights #E8EAF3, restrained violet #6153B7 reflection, a tiny magenta #F047FE glint and a small pale-yellow #E6DC6A edge reflection. Silver/graphite must dominate roughly 85% of visible surface. Replace strong electric-blue/cyan and orange/copper reflections with muted silver-violet. Preserve the broad smooth iridescent optical finish, fine surface texture and lighting structure of original. No busy streaks or new surface geometry. Highlights broad and clean. No violet background or neon glow.
Keep the full original oval geometry and tilted pose. Show the complete object with generous 10% transparent margins on every side, centered in landscape canvas, approximately 4:3 aspect ratio. Background truly transparent including central hole, no black rectangle, no floor or drop shadow. No sphere, ball, core, text, logo, UI, particles, flame or extra objects. High fidelity studio render, transparent PNG.
storyboard:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity six-frame storyboard for domfx website scroll story. 2 columns, 3 rows, exactly six wide desktop viewport panels; square total canvas preferably 2048x2048. Captions outside panels. Use attached transparent annular disc faithfully: exact oval aspect ratio, tilt, texture, raised inner lip and EMPTY central hole, silver/graphite with restrained violet/magenta/pale-yellow reflections. Never stretch/squash its image or add sphere.
All panels same flat graphite #14151B background, solid #E8EAF3 copy, #AEB1C1 body, #C2C5DB buttons, tiny 8px radii, fine borders. Cabinet Grotesk MEDIUM headings 56-64px on 1440px desktop, General Sans body18px. NOT heavy bold. No chrome lettering. Calm, minimal, large breathing room.
01 caption "01 · Quiet arrival". Header domfx left, Examples Quickstart right. Center moderate two-line heading "Effects that follow\nyour HTML.", body "Add GPU effects to real elements.", two small actions "Try the effects" "Quickstart ↗". CRITICAL CROPPING: artwork only in BOTTOM 28–30 PERCENT of viewport. Repeat same annular disc FIVE times across width in triangular composition: center largest and highest but its top starts at 70% viewport height, much of disc BELOW frame. Inner companions start at80%; outer companions at90%. Center~420px wide equivalent, inner~370, outer~320; lots of negative space, artwork NOT half the viewport. Lower side rings partly clipped off side boundaries. Only restrained Fire edge highlight, no bonfires.
02 caption "02 · Focus on PNG". One ENTIRE disc centered in viewport at around 37% width and 42% height, correct original image aspect ratio, lots of room all around. No side rings. Top-left heading "Every contour counts." Bottom-right description "Effects follow the transparent edges of your images." Original metallic disc with subtle warm Fire at outer AND inner contours. Small bottom dock "Fire   Motion   Pause".
03 caption "03 · The same shape as SVG". Same screen arrangement and exact disc outer ellipse/inner hole/tilt/size/center as02. Replace photoreal PNG with genuine FLAT VECTOR-looking annular disc: smooth filled silver-grey elliptical band, simple flat shading, clear transparent hole, a minimal inner rim, NO photographic reflections. Top-left "From pixels to paths." bottom-right "The same effect. Now on SVG." Warm thin Fire contours, same dock.
04 caption "04 · The title takes over". Disc fully disappears, center live heading "Keep the HTML." solid light interior, small Fire licking letter edges. Description directly below "Your text stays selectable. Your links keep working." This is section-sized heading rather than huge poster. Generous empty surrounding space. Small dock.
05 caption "05 · Release into the page". Pinning ends. No artwork. Heading "Built for real elements." Then three understated cards: "Keep the DOM" with "Text stays selectable."; "Follow the shape" with "PNG, SVG and live text."; "Control the motion" with "Pause or reduce motion." Quiet Quickstart link below. No fake stats or code.
06 caption "06 · Return at the footer". Quiet heading "Make your HTML come alive." and "Read the quickstart ↗". FIVE annular discs repeat SAME triangular shallow-cropped arrangement as hero near lower viewport region, center higher, side rings lower, correct aspect ratio. Footer link row below imagery: domfx left; Examples Quickstart Source Back to top right; MIT small. Full footer links visible. NO sphere anywhere.
Six sequential scroll states of one site, not six variants. The main design improvement is careful scale, lower/shallow illustration reveal at hero, and restrained clean composition. No old ribbon or split-shell illustrations; use ONLY supplied annulus throughout.
